title: P1 death-return request payload
description: Payload of POST /p1/actor/death-return (DEC-DEATH-RETURN-20261105). The envelope keeps the shared Envelope shape and the payload is deliberately empty: the caller may only express the intent to return. No map, coordinate, anchor record or destination field exists here, and a request that adds one is rejected as invalid_payload, so a client can never choose where the server puts it. The route is mapped only while P1:AlphaProfile:Enabled and P1:DeathReturn:Enabled are both true; otherwise the path does not exist and the request answers 404.
